rows.basis: Revenue of the AI Cloud segment for fiscal 2024: 3.105m of 187.192m total. The Bitcoin Mining segment's 184.087m is excluded.
Revenue of the AI Cloud segment for fiscal 2025: 16.394m of 501.023m total, matching the MD&A's 16.4m. The Bitcoin Mining segment's 484.629m is excluded.
Revenue of the AI Cloud segment for fiscal 2026: 128.795m of 707.007m total, matching the stated 128.8m. The Bitcoin Mining segment's 578.212m is excluded.

IREN targets more than 4bn of AI Cloud annualized run-rate revenue by end of calendar 2026, about 85% under contract, including about 1.9bn a year from the Microsoft contract. These are run-rate and contract figures, not fiscal-year revenue, so no amount is attributed.

Growth in gross HPC Hardware PP&E: 76.001m − 33.315m = 42.686m, shared against 573.456m of capex. This excludes AI data-center buildings and construction in progress, and gross growth can include non-cash additions.

Growth in gross GPU Hardware PP&E (the former HPC Hardware line, 76.001m at FY2025): 2,034.811m − 76.001m = 1,958.810m. The share is against the 2,998.006m PP&E payments, which exclude the 1,335.1m paid for computer hardware (mostly AI). It excludes construction in progress at Childress Horizons 1-4, Sweetwater and British Columbia (CIP rose to 3,657.072m), so it understates the AI build.
August 2025 purchase order for about 4.2k NVIDIA B200 GPUs, about 193m. The separate B300 purchase of about 71.4m is not included because a row takes one statement.

IREN says it will make significant investments for the Microsoft Agreement, GPU acquisitions and new data-center capacity, and that GPU financing is the lion's share of capex. The pack has no FY2027 dollar figure; the 25bn to 30bn from the call is not in the pack.
Stated cost of revenue for AI Cloud Services of 1.3m in fiscal 2025, against 324.704m of opex. It excludes AI-related depreciation and SG&A.
Stated cost of revenue for AI Cloud Services of 16.9m in fiscal 2026, against 1,534.015m of opex. It excludes GPU depreciation and the platform and employee costs the release links to the AI ramp.
